Safety.Banner: Safety boundary: GPT creates a constrained candidate mission only. The plugin does not upload a mission, change flight mode, arm, take off, or send RC/PWM commands.

TaskSuggestions.Title: Try a mission task
TaskSuggestions.RelativeRoute: Fly a relative route from planned Home, then return to launch.
TaskSuggestions.SurveyPolygon: Survey the polygon drawn in Flight Planner, then return to launch.
TaskSuggestions.FromFile: Read the attached mission brief and identify any missing information.
ProviderNote.CcSwitch: Start the CC Switch proxy and route first; CC Switch manages the upstream key or OAuth session.
ProviderNote.OpenAi: Use an OpenAI API key; a ChatGPT or Codex login is not itself an API key.
ProviderNote.OpenRouter: Use an OpenRouter key and a model ID supported by your account.
ProviderNote.LiteLlm: For a local LiteLLM proxy; select no authentication when the proxy has no key.
ProviderNote.LmStudio: Load a model in LM Studio and start its local server.
ProviderNote.Ollama: Start Ollama and enter the ID of a model already installed locally.
ProviderNote.NewApi: Replace the example host with your gateway; compatibility depends on its OpenAI implementation.
ProviderNote.Azure: Use the resource v1 base URL and api-key header; the model ID is normally the deployment name.
ProviderNote.Custom: Edit the base URL, protocol, authentication and model. Native Anthropic and Gemini protocols are not handled directly.
